annotations.title: Talk to the user's Apptiller team

description: Use this when the user wants to ask Apptiller's team of agents something, tell it something, or give it work: write to the Lead (or another member). It is stored as from the user's assistant, never as from the user; set changes_your_next_step to true to wake the member. Nothing the team does from it reaches a live account without the user's approval in the web app.

changes_your_next_step.description: True only if it changes what the reader or you will do next

no_numbers.description: True only when the text states no figure at all

numbers.description: Every figure the text states, each with the stored answer it came from. A figure with no reference is counted against its writer

answer_id.description: The stored answer it came from

how.description: 'cell': the value is in the answer's rows; 'derived': worked out from them

says.description: What it is, with its days: 'installs from search, 14 to 23 Nov'
